authorization: User explicitly reopened Phase 3 for materially distinct architectural iteration after V214; V197 and all nearby structural-selection, scale, loss, step, data, and seed variants remain closed.
objective: Determine whether every frozen Phi-3 transformer block can be progressively replaced by a full-residual-width LayerCake bottleneck causal module while retaining copied lexical and normalization tensors, ending with zero complete source transformer blocks and a large theoretical compute and memory margin for later physical certification.
causal_basis: V197's four-layer width-192 student was mostly overwritten by conformance and gained only five non-significant passes over random initialization. The successor preserves the teacher residual coordinate system and lexical boundary, assigns one trainable replacement to each source block, and supports layer-local function matching on replacement-induced hidden states before end-to-end conformance.
standard_method_boundary: This is progressive layerwise block distillation/model compression until ABI-specific labeling, segregation, portability, and matched controls establish a stricter claim. It is not LoRA, lossless foreign-model transfer, or evidence of ABI superiority.

target.operator_family: full-width residual stream with per-source-layer bottleneck rotary causal replacement

future_training_design_boundary.replacement_distribution: each layer trains on hidden states produced by already replaced predecessors
future_training_design_boundary.teacher_target: the corresponding frozen source block output on that exact hidden input

decision_rule: Pass only if all 195 required source tensor shapes match the frozen index, one replacement maps to every source block, the residual width remains exactly 3072, bottleneck attention geometry is valid, zero source transformer blocks remain at deployment, the fp16 payload is at most 600 MiB, the two-field calibration cache is at most 1 GiB, copied source parameters are explicit, and the maximum-context theoretical incremental MAC margin exceeds 4x. A pass authorizes only a separately governed generic LayerCake host construct. It does not authorize source tensor reads, extraction, training, measured speed, or a quality claim.
claim_boundary: No-model tensor-metadata, exact accounting, cache, and theoretical-compute feasibility only. No source values, activations, logits, outputs, training, measured runtime, English transfer, Phase 3 certification, or ABI superiority claim.
